hexcasting.category.createmanaindustry.d: Bridging the gap between industrial $(thing)Create/$ machinery and $(hex)Hexcasting/$, automating the production of $(item)casting items/$, $(item)media batteries/$, and more.
hexcasting.page.createmanaindustry.liqui: By applying mechanical force and heat to $(l:items/amethyst)$(item)Amethyst/$, I have discovered how to extract its contained _media directly into a liquid form. This $(media)pink, glowing fluid/$ is far denser than raw amethysts — a single bucket holds approximately $(thing)400,000/$ media units, enough to fully charge several $(l:items/hexcasting)$(item)Cyphers/$.

$(media)Liquid Media/$ is a $(thing)Create fluid/$ that condenses raw Hexcasting _media into a form transportable through $(thing)Fluid Pipes/$. It glows with a soft pink light, making it easy to spot in tanks and basins.

$(thing)Heated Compaction/$ converts amethyst materials directly into $(media)Liquid Media/$:$(br)$(li)$(item)Amethyst Dust/$ — 25 mB$(br)$(li)$(item)Amethyst Shard/$ — 125 mB$(br)$(li)$(item)Charged Amethyst/$ — 250 mB$(br2)The compaction process requires $(thing)heat/$; an ordinary $(item)Blaze Burner/$ suffices. Each recipe's output is dynamically scaled based on $(thing)config values/$.

$(media)Liquid Media/$ can be further processed:$(br)$(li)$(thing)Heated Mixing/$ converts it to $(item)Liquid Mana/$ at a 1:1 ratio.$(br)$(li)$(thing)Mist Mixing/$ in a $(item)Kinetic Atomizer/$ atomizes $(item)Liquid Mana/$ back into a $(media)Liquid Media/$ vapour field.$(br)$(li)A $(item)Condenser/$ placed in the mist gathers it back as usable $(media)Liquid Media/$, completing the circulation roundtrip.
hexcasting.page.createmanaindustry.autom: The production of $(l:items/hexcasting)$(thing)Casting Items/$ — $(item)Cyphers/$, $(item)Trinkets/$, and $(item)Artifacts/$ — can be fully automated using Create's $(thing)Deployer/$, $(thing)Spout/$, and $(thing)Mechanical Press/$ in a simple three-step pipeline. The resulting items are indistinguishable from those crafted by hand.

$(bold)Step 1: Writing Patterns/$ - $(thing)$(l:items/scroll)An Iota-Holding Item/$ (a $(item)Scroll/$, $(item)Spellbook/$, $(item)Abacus/$, $(item)Slate/$, or $(item)Thought-Knot/$) is held by a $(thing)Deployer/$ aimed at a freshly-crafted casting item on a $(thing)Depot/$. The Deployer copies one pattern onto the item, producing its $(thing)Incomplete/$ variant. Multiple passes can append multiple Iotas.$(br2)The held item is not consumed.

$(bold)Step 2: Filling Media/$ - A $(thing)Spout/$ pumps $(l:createmanaindustry/liquid_media)$(media)Liquid Media/$ into the incomplete item. Each item can hold up to:$(br)$(li)$(item)Cypher/$ — 6,400,000 media$(br)$(li)$(item)Trinket/$ — 64,000,000 media$(br)$(li)$(item)Artifact/$ — 640,000,000 media$(br2)Each spout operation fills up to one bucket's worth of media. Multiple passes fill it completely. Capacities are configurable.

$(bold)Step 3: Finalizing/$ - A $(thing)Mechanical Press/$ stamps the pattern-laden, media-filled incomplete item into its finished form. All accumulated $(thing)Iotas/$, $(action)patterns/$, _media, and $(item)pigment/$ are transferred intact, yielding a fully functional casting item ready for $(l:casting/101)$(action)spellcasting/$.
hexcasting.page.createmanaindustry.media: $(l:greatwork/spellcircles#hexcasting:craft/battery)$(action)Phials of Media/$ can be mass-produced through Create automation. A $(thing)Deployer/$ holding a $(item)Large Scroll/$ inscribed with the $(action)Craft Battery/$ pattern combines it with a $(item)Glass Bottle/$ on a $(thing)Depot/$ to create an $(thing)Incomplete Media Battery/$.$(br2)The scroll must carry the correct op_id — any other scroll is rejected.

The incomplete battery is then $(thing)filled/$ with $(l:createmanaindustry/liquid_media)$(media)Liquid Media/$ via a $(thing)Spout/$ and $(thing)pressed/$ in a $(item)Mechanical Press/$ into a completed $(item)Phial of Media/$ with a capacity of $(thing)640,000,000/$ media.$(br2)The battery's final capacity is set to the exact amount of media filled — you decide how much energy it stores.

Once finalized, $(item)Phials of Media/$ can be $(thing)filled/$ or $(thing)drained/$ of $(media)Liquid Media/$ directly through Create's $(thing)Fluid Pipes/$ when placed on a $(thing)Depot/$, belt, or in a spout slot — making them ideal $(thing)media buffers/$ for balancing supply and demand in automated Hexcasting systems.
hexcasting.page.createmanaindustry.read_: I have developed a pattern that reads $(thing)Iotas/$ from items resting on Create's $(item)Depot/$ or $(item)Placard/$ without needing to pick them up. This bridges the gap between physical item manipulation and abstract _Hexcasting.$(br2)It consumes a single $(thing)vector/$ — the block position — and pushes the stored $(thing)Iota/$ onto the stack.$(br2)This pattern costs $(thing)0 media/$ to cast — it is a simple information read.

If the targeted block is not a Depot or Placard, the block holds no item, or the item does not hold an Iota, the spell fails with a $(thing)mishap/$ — the target position is reported in the error for easy debugging.

This action can also be applied onto a $(l:items/slate)$(item)Blank Slate/$ through $(thing)Stonecutting/$ — simply place a blank Slate in a $(thing)Stonecutter/$ and select $(action)Read Iota From Block/$ from the list.$(br2)See the $(l:createmanaindustry/slate_stonecutting)$(thing)Slate Pattern Stonecutting/$ entry for details.
hexcasting.page.createmanaindustry.light: I have devised a pattern that lights a $(item)Blaze Burner/$ or an $(item)Allay Burner/$ from afar. It consumes a $(thing)vector/$ — the block position — and a $(thing)number/$ — the burn time in seconds — then adds exactly that much burn time to the burner.$(br2)Media is charged per second, at the same rate the burner itself consumes media, so the spell is economically equivalent to pouring in $(l:createmanaindustry/liquid_media)$(media)Liquid Media/$.

A Blaze Burner holding no blaze cannot be lit by this spell, and a $(thing)SEETHING/$ or creative burner is left untouched. If the targeted block is not a lit Blaze Burner or an Allay Burner, the spell fails with a $(thing)mishap/$ — the target position is reported in the error for easy debugging.$(br2)Like all non-great-spell patterns, it can also be stamped onto a $(l:items/slate)$(item)Blank Slate/$ via $(thing)Stonecutting/$.
hexcasting.page.createmanaindustry.slate: $(thing)Create: Mana Industry/$ dynamically registers $(thing)Stonecutting/$ recipes that let you stamp any non-great-spell Hexcasting pattern directly onto a $(l:items/slate)$(item)Blank Slate/$.$(br2)These recipes are generated automatically at server startup and after every $(thing)/reload/$, reflecting the exact registry of installed $(action)patterns/$ — including those from other addon mods.

To use this feature:$(br)$(li)Place a $(item)Blank Slate/$ in a $(thing)Stonecutter/$$(br)$(li)Scroll through the list — recipes are grouped by mod namespace$(br)$(li)Select the desired pattern to produce a $(thing)pre-patterned Slate/$$(br2)The resulting slate can then be copied through standard $(thing)Pattern Transcription/$ just like any other pre-patterned slate.

$(thing)Great Spells/$ (those marked with $(hex)PER_WORLD_PATTERN/$) are intentionally excluded from Stonecutting. These powerful patterns must still be obtained through the $(l:greatwork/brainsweep)$(action)traditional methods of Hexcasting exploration/$ — Stonecutting cannot replicate their complexity.
hexcasting.page.createmanaindustry.media: The conversion between raw amethyst materials and $(l:createmanaindustry/liquid_media)$(media)Liquid Media/$ is handled by $(thing)Heated Compaction/$:$()$(br)$(li)1x $(item)Amethyst Dust/$ → 25 mB (worth ~10,000 media)$(br)$(li)1x $(item)Amethyst Shard/$ → 125 mB (worth ~50,000 media)$(br)$(li)1x $(item)Charged Amethyst/$ → 250 mB (worth ~100,000 media)$(br2)Output amounts dynamically scale with both the server's $(thing)mediaPerBucket/$ config and Hexcasting's own $(thing)media value/$ configs.

$(media)Liquid Media/$ and $(item)Liquid Mana/$ are interconvertible:$(br)$(li)$(thing)Heated Mixing/$: $(media)Liquid Media/$ → $(item)Liquid Mana/$ (1:1)$(br)$(li)$(thing)Mist Mixing/$ (Kinetic Atomizer): $(item)Liquid Mana/$ → $(media)Liquid Media/$ vapour$(br)$(li)$(thing)Condenser/$: recovers $(media)Liquid Media/$ from mist$(br2)This bidirectional conversion lets you balance between creating charged $(item)Knots/$ and filling $(thing)casting items/$ with media.

$(bold)Configuration/$ - The following values control media conversion (all editable in the server config):$(br)$(li)$(thing)mediaPerBucket/$ — 400,000 (media per bucket of Liquid Media)$(br)$(li)$(thing)cypherMaxMedia/$ — 6,400,000$(br)$(li)$(thing)trinketMaxMedia/$ — 64,000,000$(br)$(li)$(thing)artifactMaxMedia/$ — 640,000,000$(br)$(li)$(thing)batteryMaxMedia/$ — 640,000,000$(br2)Changing these values also updates recipe outputs automatically.
createmanaindustry.ponder.allay_burner/s: Amethyst materials can be used as fuel for the Allay Burner
Right-click the burner with Amethyst Shards, Amethyst Dust, or Charged Amethyst to add burn time
The burn time scales with the media value of the amethyst
createmanaindustry.ponder.allay_burner/l: Liquid Media can be poured or piped into the burner's internal tank
The tank holds up to one bucket of Liquid Media, which is used once solid fuel runs out
Solid fuel always takes priority over Liquid Media
createmanaindustry.ponder.allay_burner/c: Right-click an Allay with the empty burner to capture it
The captured Allay will provide Heat to the burner and dance while it burns
Music Discs can be inserted and played like a Jukebox
Place the burner below a Basin to process recipes requiring Allay Heat
createmanaindustry.ponder.allay_burner/m: While burning, the Allay Burner emits a field of Liquid Soul mist
The mist can be reclaimed with a Condenser and is required for mist-based recipes
